newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cold, Tokyo sharply up on results.
newsitem.headline: Cold, Tokyo sharply up on results.

text.p: Shares of Ceylon Cold Stores Ltd and Tokyo Cement (Lanka) Ltd were up in early Friday trade, due to good interim results for the period to June, brokers said.
Cold Stores rose 2.27 percent or five rupees to 225, Tokyo Cement 1.47 percent or 1.25 rupees to 86.
"Both corporates have seen very good interim results, which is fuelling demand for sthe share," said a local broker.
Cold Stores saw net profits for the three months to June, rise 197 percent to 61.48 million rupees. Tokyo Cement profits for the same peirod rose 260 percent to 43.56 million rupees.
